text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pendaftaran Ahli Farmasi

(Pindaan Jadual Pertama) 2021.

Pindaan Jadual Pertama

2. Jadual Pertama kepada Akta Pendaftaran Ahli Farmasi 1951 dipinda berhubung

dengan negara "Malaysia", dengan menggantikan butiran "QUEST International

University Perak (QIUP)" dengan butiran "Quest International University (QIU)

(formerly known as QUEST International University Perak (QIUP))".

Dibuat 5 Ogos 2021

[KKM.R.600-1/1/26Jld. 3(33); PN(PU2)200/V]

DATO' SRI DR. ADHAM BIN BABA

Menteri Kesihatan

REGISTRATION OF PHARMACISTS ACT 1951

REGISTRATION OF PHARMACISTS (AMENDMENT OF FIRST SCHEDULE) ORDER 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 6(3) of the

Registration of Pharmacists Act 1951 [Act 371], the Minister, after consulting the Board,

makes the following order:
